name: DIACEREIN/MELOXICAM 50 MG/15 MG 20 CAPSULES
description: Diacerein 50 mg 30 capsules Viaflex is an anti-arthritic medication indicated for the treatment of symptoms of osteoarthritis of the knee and hip in adults. It acts as an anti-inflammatory, inhibiting the production of interleukin-1, a substance that plays an important role in cartilage degradation. Osteoarthritis.
